sentence_stem: My brother can swim very well, but
full_sentence: My brother can swim very well, but he can't ride a bike.

options.text: he likes swimming in the sea.
options.why_wrong: This describes a preference, not an ability, so it does not contrast with 'can swim' after 'but'.
This repeats the idea of swimming instead of giving a contrasting ability after 'but'.
This describes his height and does not contrast with his ability to swim.

explanation: After 'but', we need a clause that shows a contrast with the first part. Use 'can't' with a verb in its base form to show a lack of ability.
translation: Mój brat umie bardzo dobrze pływać, ale nie potrafi jeździć na rowerze.
